Jordan —

Great questions; short answers below and I’ve attached a one-page rollback checklist in the Drive link. Happy to go into details on the kickoff call.

1) Canary thresholds (proposal):
   - Error rate: < 0.5% 5xx across the canary pool (measured per 1h window)
   - Latency: P95 < 350ms for token generation on the 2048 token baseline (we include perf guard rails in the MAP)
   - Quality: automated eval let-through — no more than a 3% increase in semantic-drift false positive rate vs. baseline prompt set (we’ll run nightly ROC/AUC-like checks)
   - Escalation: any single metric breach persists for >30m triggers immediate investigation and >60m triggers rollback to previous variant

2) Training cohort recordings: yes — admin cohort recorded; ops cohort we’ll run interactive labs and capture clips. The slides are attached and we’ll publish recordings to the shared Drive within 24h.

3) PO / SOW: Vivek, Laura — can you provide the Dedicated reservation line items (SKU, hours/commit) and a short SOW paragraph so Jordan’s procurement can issue the PO?

Next actions:
- Vivek / Laura to drop SOW snippet by EOD 6/26
- Jordan to confirm SRE overlap window for canary by 6/28
- I’ll schedule the 30-min kickoff for 7/06 (tentative)

Cheers,
David
